title: Design a requirements map and roadmap in docs/design
summary: Retry of the earlier job. Write docs/design/requirements-map.md: a requirements map built from BRIEF.md and its addenda, with status, owning design and serving jobs per requirement. It also holds the living strategy view (A1) and a roadmap that sequences the queued work. Every citation must be real, and the earlier invented D46 quote and the off-by-one BRIEF.md line must not recur. Design doc only.

defaults_applied.how: Every status and claim cites a verified file and line, and any number is measured or labeled as an estimate.
The design doc lists the alternatives considered.
One focused doc, with no code.
Written so an outside reader can follow it.
The original request text and the verifier findings supply the missing detail.

assumptions: The previous attempt's file was not kept, so the doc is written afresh. docs/design/requirements-map.md is not in the repository.
The verifier's two findings are corrections to apply: cite the athena-v0.md status line for O1, and use the correct BRIEF.md line numbers.
The producer re-reads BRIEF.md, docs/decisions.md and the existing design docs to ground every citation.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/requirements-map.md exists and has a requirements table with one row per BRIEF.md requirement, addenda included. Each row has a status, an owning design doc and the serving jobs.

Every quote and line citation is real. Each quoted string appears verbatim at the cited file and line, and line numbers match (for example, the BRIEF.md permission to use GitHub features and the ban on pushing upstream are on adjacent lines and are not swapped).
The O1 row's `built` status cites the status line of docs/design/athena-v0.md. It does not cite D46, which concerns per-job build directories.
The doc contains a living strategy view (A1) that says how it is kept current.
The doc contains a roadmap that sequences the queued work, with the order justified and the dependencies stated.
The doc covers alternatives considered, per the designed default.
Only design/doc files change. No code, governance files or records/ change.
Run `git status` and `git diff --stat`. Only docs, and optionally CHANGELOG.md, are touched, and `cargo fmt --check` still passes.

out_of_scope: Any code, tests or tooling that generates or validates the map
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml, CI or other governance files
Editing BRIEF.md or other existing design docs
departures: The reference forecast is kept. Acceptance is slightly higher because the verifier's two findings are specific and fixable. Verification is slightly lower because the doc's many citations each risk a repeat of the fabricated-quote failure.
